items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 3:57 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Staff Reports
Inclusionary Zoning Policies - 200 Victoria Street South, DSD-2024-149
notes:
Council considered Development Services Department report DSD-2024-149, entitled Supplemental Report to DSD 2024-111 - Inclusionary Zoning for 97-101 Park Street and 186-194 Victoria Street South, dated March 21, 2024, recommending the property municipally addressed as 97-101 Park Street and 186-194 Victoria Street South be approved for an Official Plan Amendment and Zone Change to impose inclusionary zoning, as recommended at the January 29, 2024 Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee, further considered at the March 18, 2024 Council meeting and deferred for consideration to this date.

Victor Labreche, Arcadis Professional Services (Canada) Inc. addressed Council in opposition to the staff recommendation outlined in Supplemental Report DSD-2024-111, noting staff provided an alternative recommendation outlined in bullet three of the report highlights which have an alternative recommendation, to advance a site specific approach for affordable housing for these properties in line with its June 2023 decision, which were outlined in Attachments 'D' and 'E' of the report.  V. Labreche stated they were in support of the alternative recommendation and requested Council adopt the site specific zoning for the subject property.

motions.item_title: Resolution of Support for AMO Board Nomination (Dan Chapman), CAO-2024-151
motions.text: "That the Council of the City of Kitchener nominate Dan Chapman, Chief Administrative Officer, for the position of Secretary-Treasurer on the AMO Board of Directors for the 2024-2026 term, including the cost of reasonable expenses associated with Board membership, as outlined in Chief Administrative Officer report CAO-2024-051."

motions.item_title: Official Plan Amendment Application OPA23/020/K/KA, Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/035/K/KA, Enabling Four Units, DSD-2024-066
motions.text: "That City-Initiated Official Plan Amendment OPA23/020/K/KA, for the purpose of permitting up to 4 dwelling units on lots which permit a single detached dwelling, semi-detached dwelling or street-townhouse dwelling, be adopted, in the form shown in the Official Plan Amendment attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066 as Attachment ‘A’, and accordingly forwarded to the Region of Waterloo for approval; and, That City Initiated Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/035/K/KA to amend Zoning By-law 85-1, be approved in the form shown in the “Proposed By-law” attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066 as Attachment ‘B1’; and, That City Initiated Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/035/K/KA to amend Zoning By-law 2019-051, be approved in the form shown in the “Proposed By-law” attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066 as Attachment ‘B2’; and further, That Staff provide data regarding the number of 4-unit dwellings, including discrete Additional Dwelling Units constructed following approval of the “Proposed By-law” attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066, and report back to the Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee by the Fall of 2025 with additional recommendations, or to provide or information if no additional recommendations are proposed."
motions.text_html:
"That City-Initiated Official Plan Amendment OPA23/020/K/KA, for the purpose of permitting up to 4 dwelling units on lots which permit a single detached dwelling, semi-detached dwelling or street-townhouse dwelling, be adopted, in the form shown in the Official Plan Amendment attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066 as Attachment ‘A’, and accordingly forwarded to the Region of Waterloo for approval; and,

That City Initiated Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/035/K/KA to amend Zoning By-law 85-1, be approved in the form shown in the “Proposed By-law” attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066 as Attachment ‘B1’; and,

That City Initiated Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/035/K/KA to amend Zoning By-law 2019-051, be approved in the form shown in the “Proposed By-law” attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066 as Attachment ‘B2’; and further,

That Staff provide data regarding the number of 4-unit dwellings, including discrete Additional Dwelling Units constructed following approval of the “Proposed By-law” attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2024-066, and report back to the Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee by the Fall of 2025 with additional recommendations, or to provide or  information if no additional recommendations are proposed."
